events.did: scaled the outside of the roller coaster and braced himself against the rail at the top
events.quote_anchor: his palms were still sweating as he scaled the outside of the roller coaster. He reached the top and braced himself against the rail

events.did: reported “In position.” into the comm and said “I see you.”
events.quote_anchor: “In position,” Mitch said into the comm. “I see you.”

events.did: scanned the park through the scope for EON agents and for Syd, finding only the red lights of a second transport van
events.quote_anchor: He brought the scope to his eyes again and scanned the park, searching for other signs of life, for EON agents, for Syd.

events.did: told Victor to take the path to the place it splits and go right, panning to the MADMAN’S MANSION facade
events.quote_anchor: “But I can see the ride. You’re heading in the right direction. Just take the path to the place it splits and go right.”

events.did: searched MADMAN’S MANSION for some sign of the kid and proof she was alive
events.quote_anchor: There were no windows, but he still searched, desperate for some sign of the kid, some proof she was alive, and safe

events.did: found Victor no longer heading for the ride but sitting on a bench in an open square, exposed
events.quote_anchor: There. Mitch found him, no longer heading for the ride, but sitting on a bench in an open square, exposed.

events.did: saw a third black van arrive and watched four dark shapes spill out of the carrier as reinforcements
events.quote_anchor: Doors swung open, and four dark shapes spilled out.

events.did: opened his eyes and began to climb down
events.quote_anchor: And then he opened his eyes and began to climb down.

relations.did: told Mitch he had had his chance to help and had failed, a memory that still cut
relations.quote_anchor: You had your chance to help. And you failed.

relations.did: was torn between his cellmate’s order and the trouble heading toward him
relations.quote_anchor: He wavered, torn between his cellmate’s order and the trouble heading toward him.

relations.did: taught Sydney to keep moving and to escape an ambush, and remembers her curled on the sofa with Dol
relations.quote_anchor: Sydney curled on the sofa while he made dinner, Dol beside her, head resting on her feet.

numbers.did: four sides to Bethany Adventure Land. Four ways in, and out
numbers.quote_anchor: There were four sides to Bethany Adventure Land. Four ways in, and out.

numbers.did: a second transport van positioned at the far end of the park
numbers.quote_anchor: the red lights of a second transport van positioned at the far end of the park, beyond another metal gate

numbers.did: the arriving vehicle was a third black van
numbers.quote_anchor: Just then, a set of headlights cut through the thinning dark. A third black van.
Doors swung open, and four dark shapes spilled out.
“You’re going the wrong way,” said Mitch as the agents poured through the second gate.
